## Contributor checklist

- [ ] The linked proposal has `status:approved-to-build` and an unexpired approval.
- [ ] This pull request has exactly one ARCHMAGE rank label.
- [ ] All changes remain within the approved issue scope.
- [ ] Regression tests cover changed behavior.
- [ ] Coverage does not decrease.
- [ ] Benchmark evidence or a valid `N/A` reason is included.
- [ ] Security impact is explained.
- [ ] Documentation is updated or justified as `N/A`.
- [ ] Backward compatibility is preserved or explicitly documented.
- [ ] Every commit includes a DCO `Signed-off-by` trailer.
